stage: J-FAMP runbook Stage 2 (candidate quantization and clean evaluation)
scope: weight-only: Conv2d/Linear weights (21 tensors, 11164352 weights) are quantized; biases, BatchNorm parameters, running statistics and activations stay FP32
independence: each format is generated from the original FP32 checkpoint, never from another format

metric_definitions.sqnr_db: 10*log10(sum_i w_i^2 / sum_i (w_i - w^_i)^2), signal = FP32 weights, noise = FP32 weights minus decoded weights; per layer, and GLOBAL pooled over all 21 tensors (sums of powers, paper Eq. 6); float64
metric_definitions.mse/rmse/mae/max_abs_error: of w - w^ over the tensor (GLOBAL: pooled; MAE is the weight-weighted mean)
metric_definitions.n_clipped: weights whose magnitude exceeded the format's range before rounding (saturated)
metric_definitions.zeroed_from_nonzero: weights that are nonzero in FP32 but decode to exactly 0
metric_definitions.accuracy: top-1 correct / total; drop_pp = FP32 accuracy - candidate accuracy on the SAME images
metric_definitions.cross_entropy: mean over images of the softmax cross-entropy, same images and criterion for all formats
metric_definitions.storage: payload_bytes = actual bytes of the stored words; scale_bytes = float32 scales; padding_bits = bits in payload beyond n*bits (INT4 odd count); total_bytes = payload + scales + codec metadata (none); theoretical_bits = n * bits, reported separately
metric_definitions.compression_ratio_weights: FP32 Conv/Linear weight bytes (44657408) / total_bytes (payload + scales); excludes biases, BatchNorm parameters and buffers
metric_definitions.compression_ratio_full_model: FP32 model bytes incl. non-quantized parameters and buffers (44734408) / (total_bytes + non-quantized parameters 38440 B + buffers 38560 B, both left FP32)

evaluation.precision: FP32 compute on decoded weights, model.eval(), inference_mode
evaluation.test: official 10,000 test images, evaluated only by --stage test after this manifest exists

config.rounding: round-to-nearest, ties to even (np.rint on the integer mantissa); mantissa carry increments the exponent
config.saturation_clipping: |w| clipped to max finite 255.9375 before encoding
config.nan_inf: encoder rejects non-finite input; decoder reads the reserved all-ones exponent (es=15) as es=14 ('clamp'), reachable only through bit flips
config.storage: actual encoded uint16 words; decoded to FP32 for evaluation (weight-only)

config.rounding: round-to-nearest, ties to even (NumPy float32 -> float16 cast)

fp16.quantization_simulated_or_packed: stored in the actual encoded representation (uint16 / uint8 words, INT4 packed two per byte); evaluation decodes them to FP32

config.subnormal_behavior: enabled: es=0 stores m * 2^-9 (smallest nonzero magnitude 2^-9 = 0.001953)
config.finite_nan_handling: no infinities; exactly one NaN magnitude pattern S.1111.111 (0x7F / 0xFF); all other 254 words are finite; max finite 448 (S.1111.110); min normal 2^-6
config.rounding: round-to-nearest, ties to the even word (= IEEE round-to-nearest-even)
config.saturation_clipping: |w| > 448 saturates to 448 (the encoder never produces the NaN pattern)
config.scale: none (UNSCALED: weights smaller than 2^-10 round to zero)
config.nan_inf: encoder rejects non-finite input; decoder maps the NaN pattern to NaN
config.storage: actual encoded uint8 words; decoded to FP32 for evaluation (weight-only)

config.bit_layout: 8-bit two's complement signed integer code; one code per byte
config.scale: s = max|w| / 127 computed once per tensor (per layer), stored as one float32 (4 bytes); an all-zero tensor gets s = 1
config.granularity: per-tensor (one scale per layer's weight tensor)

config.rounding: round-to-nearest, ties to even (np.rint) of w/s computed in float64 with the float32 scale
config.signed_range: [-128, 127] (clip); with s = max|w|/127 the code -128 is not reached
config.nan_inf: encoder rejects non-finite input; no NaN/Inf codes exist; a flipped float32 scale can be non-finite (not touched in Stage 2)
config.storage: actual encoded bytes + float32 scale; decoded to FP32 for evaluation (weight-only)
